methods.description: Take the highest common numerical factor, dividing both terms and preserving signs.
Take the pronumeral common to both terms.
Combine coefficient HCF and lowest common pronumeral powers.
Take the HCF of every term, including a constant equal to that HCF.
Recognise a remaining common factor and complete factorisation.
Verify a factorisation by distributing the outside factor.
